name: Wastescape Battlemage
blocked_sentences: When you cast this spell, if it was kicked with its {G} kicker, exile target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
When you cast this spell, if it was kicked with its {1}{U} kicker, return target creature an opponent controls to its owner's hand.

needs.what: A card-level list of independent kicker costs (702.33c 'Kicker [cost 1] and/or [cost 2]'): the caster may pay any subset of them, including none, as the spell is cast, plus a condition that asks which specific kicker was paid (e.g. {"kicked": 0} / {"kicked": 1}) readable from a spell_cast trigger's condition and from effects
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `kicker` is a single mana string and the `kicked` condition is one bool, so it cannot say which of two kickers was paid. `spree` takes a subset of priced modes but requires a non-empty subset (the unkicked cast would be lost). `additional_cost_options` with `additional_optional` is exclusive (one branch), so paying both kickers is impossible. `multikicker` is one price paid N times, not two distinct prices with distinct effects
